title: Clear leaves from the base of the windshield
instruction: Pick up the leaves gathered below the windshield and put them in the tray. Clear any leaves covering the drain grilles.
setup: Full 3.76 m compact hatchback with a 90 cm cowl, two open slotted drains, parked wipers and a hood-mounted collection tray. Four leaves sit in the gutter. Two six-axis I2RT YAM arms with linear grippers are mounted on exterior stands.
scoring: Three points per leaf in the tray and two points per grille with less than 5% leaf coverage across the open slots. Divide by sixteen. Slot coverage is estimated from area-weighted vertical rays against the leaf meshes.
reset_notes: Rebuild the scene at its fixed initial poses and settle for 1.32 seconds.
fidelity: Joint-actuated I2RT YAM models, physical pad contact with curled rigid leaf approximations, a fixed collision-enabled cowl, and full car exterior. The bodywork outside the working area is mainly visual.
scores: Two-YAM scripted MuJoCo prototype: 1.0. Dream-1 0.00 after 600 actions.
